title: ATP Session Freshness State
description: Tracks within-session freshness of loaded variables. Detects when session-cache vars have aged past their within-session TTL.

session_ttl_minutes.description: Within-session TTL in minutes. Null = no within-session expiry.

status.description: fresh=within TTL. aging=past 75% of TTL, re-verify recommended. stale=TTL exceeded, re-verify required. re-verified=was stale, re-verify ran and passed.

use_count.description: Number of times this var was accessed this session
